overview: The Lexus TX is a 3-row luxury midsize/full-size SUV introduced for MY2024. Electrified variants include TX 500h (turbo hybrid AWD, 366 hp) and TX 550h+ PHEV (using the V6 PHEV system, 404 hp combined). Shared platform with Toyota Grand Highlander. Sources: https://www.lexus.com/models/TX , https://pressroom.lexus.com/all-new-2024-lexus-tx/
